_approach: Jump-up hype build: the punchy jump-up bounce intensifies rather than stripping back - the kick/snare stay locked, the offbeat open-hat skank doubles into a 16th pattern, and a clap roll fires through the last beat into a crash-topped final hit, the festival hands-up lift that separates jump-up's build from neuro's edit-driven tension. Ref: Preset Drive's jump-up production guide (punchy, direct drums, hooky bounce); Melodigging's neurofunk-vs-jumpup contrast on catchy vs. technical builds.
